title: NexStore AI — full-stack storefront
description: An e-commerce app built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript and Supabase. Catalogue search with a hand-written lexical ranker, cart, Stripe Checkout with server-side price verification, Row Level Security on every table, an admin panel, and a CI pipeline running typecheck, lint, unit tests and a production build.

title: Modern JS Todo
description: A todo app in vanilla JavaScript: dark mode, persistence in localStorage, filtering by priority and category, search and inline editing. Written without a framework to work through DOM APIs and state management by hand.

title: This portfolio site
description: Multi-page static site on Vite and Tailwind CSS v4, organised feature-sliced. TypeScript in strict mode, an accessible modal with a focus trap, theme switching without a flash of the wrong theme, and a Lighthouse budget checked in CI.

title: Bootstrap landing page
description: A responsive landing page built on Bootstrap with jQuery plugins and custom CSS animations. An early exercise in working inside someone else's grid system and component conventions.
